Cc: security_ops@bluebridge.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questionnaire follow-up + list of artifacts we need

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks for the SIG responses you returned last week. BlueBridge's security team reviewed the draft and came back with a short set of clarifying asks before we can move to the next stage of our procurement review. Could you confirm whether you can provide the following by Dec 10?

- SOC 2 report (latest period) — full report or assessor letter
- High-level pen test summary (executive page + scope)
- ISO statements (ISO 27001 excerpt / attestation if available)
- Security overview deck for executive review

If anything above needs additional context, happy to hop on a 30-minute call. We want to confirm scope (C2/C3 type questions) and sign off the SIG responses after we reconcile the artifacts.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Ng
Senior Security Program Manager | BlueBridge Health
alice.ng@bluebridge.com

Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up + list of artifacts we need

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick plan:

- SOC 2: we can share the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where required) by end of next week.
- Pen test: I'll ask Monica to pull the executive summary and confirmation of in-scope systems.
- ISO: we have an ISO27001 statement and scope excerpt; will include a short note on applicability.
- Deck: security overview deck (exec-friendly) — will send a PDF.

Timeline: aiming to provide a single secure delivery (Drive link + DocuSign acknowledgement) by 2026-12-10. If you need anything sooner for approvals, tell me which item to prioritize.

Looping in Monica to own the pen test artifact and Marissa for any contractual or redaction questions.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Team — quick internal note to align before we hand anything off to BlueBridge. Points: 

1) Monica — can you extract the executive summary (1 page) from the latest pen test and confirm the in-scope asset list (hosts/services) we will permit to be shared? BlueBridge asked explicitly for scope.
2) Marissa — please advise on acceptable redaction level for the SOC 2 (we normally redact sensitive network details and customer identifiers). Also confirm if legal wants a BAA/acknowledgement to accompany the share.
3) I'll prepare the security deck and consolidate the four artifacts into a single secure folder and DocuSign acknowledgement.

Please reply with ETA; target delivery to BlueBridge is EOD 2026-12-10. If anyone needs more time, flag now.

Thanks,
Rishi

- SOC2_Report_Redwood_2025.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report — redacted for third-party customer IDs)

Please confirm receipt and whether you need an abbreviated pen test one-pager for your execs — we can produce that tomorrow.

Best,

Rishi — received, thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of follow-ups: 

- The artifacts look good for initial review. Can you confirm the pen test scope in one sentence (e.g., "external web + API endpoints and selected infra") for our executive summary?
- We would appreciate a one-page executive summary of the top three findings (impact + remediation status) separate from the full pen test summary you shared. Could you deliver that by 2026-12-14?
- Finally, we'll review the SOC 2 redacted copy; procurement may ask for the unredacted report under an NDA. If that happens we'll open an NDA request and loop in your legal.

If you can send the one-pager and the one-sentence scope confirmation, we'll move to sign-off the SIG responses next week.

Thanks,
Alice
